title: Balak and Balaam

questions.question: Who was Balak son of Zippor?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:4 (ESV): "Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time."

questions.question: Who did Balak send for to curse Israel?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:5 (ESV): "He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor..."

questions.question: Where was Balaam from?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:5 (ESV): "...at Pethor, which is near the River..."

questions.question: What did God initially say to Balaam?
options: "You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."
questions.correctAnswer: "You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:12 (ESV): "God said to Balaam, 'You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.'"

questions.question: When Balaam went with the princes later, what stood in his way?
options: The angel of the Lord with a drawn sword
questions.correctAnswer: The angel of the Lord with a drawn sword
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:22 (ESV): "But God's anger was kindled... and the angel of the Lord took his stand in the way as his adversary."

questions.question: What saw the angel first?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:23 (ESV): "And the donkey saw the angel of the Lord standing in the road..."

questions.question: How many times did Balaam strike his donkey?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:28 (ESV): "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"

questions.question: What miraculous thing did the donkey do?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:28 (ESV): "Then the Lord opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam..."

questions.question: When Balaam's eyes were opened, what did he do?
options: He bowed down and fell on his face
questions.correctAnswer: He bowed down and fell on his face
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:31 (ESV): "And he bowed down and fell on his face."

questions.question: What did the angel warn Balaam to speak?
options: "Only the word that I shall speak to you"
questions.correctAnswer: "Only the word that I shall speak to you"
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:35 (ESV): "Go with the men, but speak only the word that I tell you."

questions.question: What reason did Balak give for wanting Israel cursed?
options: They are too mighty for me
questions.correctAnswer: They are too mighty for me
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:6 (ESV): "Come now, curse this people for me, since they are too mighty for me."

questions.question: Did God give Balaam permission to go the second time?
options: Yes, "rise, go with them; but only do what I tell you"
No, he went against God's will entirely
An angel told him to go
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, "rise, go with them; but only do what I tell you"
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:20 (ESV): "If the men have come to call you, rise, go with them..." (Though His anger kindled because he went - seemingly with wrong motive).

questions.question: Where did the donkey crush Balaam's foot?
options: Against a wall in a narrow path between vineyards
questions.correctAnswer: Against a wall in a narrow path between vineyards
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:24-25 (ESV): "The angel... stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on either side... crushed Balaam's foot against the wall."

questions.question: The elders of Moab and Midian departed with what in their hands?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:7 (ESV): "So the elders... departed with the fees for divination in their hand."

questions.question: Where did Balak meet Balaam initially?
questions.explanation: Numbers 22:36 (ESV): "When Balak heard... he went out to meet him at the city of Moab..."

key_verse_text: Balaam said to Balak, 'Behold, I have come to you! Have I now any power of my own to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that must I speak.'
